meta.title: Nazar Yankevych — Front-End Developer (React, Next.js, Shopify)
meta.description: Front-End Developer with 3+ years of commercial experience: React/Next.js apps, Shopify stores and conversion-focused websites. Case studies, experience and contacts.

hero.tagline: I build fast, conversion-focused web products — from Figma to pixel-perfect, accessible UI. A marketing background helps me ship interfaces that convert, not just look good.

about.title: Developer with a marketer's eye
about.p1: I'm a Front-End Developer from Kremenchuk, Ukraine, with 3+ years of commercial experience building React/Next.js applications, WordPress sites and Shopify stores.
about.p2: Before code I studied digital marketing and targeted ads, so I think about every screen in terms of user behavior, speed and conversion. Today I work on a Shopify storefront for a fitness brand and build React apps and websites end-to-end.
